# Vendored front-end libraries

Served locally so the website works without internet access. Do not edit these files.
Each file was downloaded from both cdn.jsdelivr.net and unpkg.com and accepted only when the bytes matched.

| Library | Version | Licence | Files |
|---|---|---|---|
| three.js | 0.160.0 | MIT (`three/LICENSE`) | `three/three.module.min.js`, `three/RoundedBoxGeometry.js` |
| GSAP + ScrollTrigger | 3.12.5 | GreenSock Standard "no charge" licence, https://gsap.com/standard-license (declared in `gsap/package.json` and `gsap/README.md`) | `gsap/gsap.min.js`, `gsap/ScrollTrigger.min.js` |
